title: kbmon puts what needs the operator first, one row per sprint, from one implementation
goal: a needs-you line heads the view and the status answer, naming open operator gates, blocked sprints, a refused delivery, real orphans, low disk and a checkout that cannot fast-forward with why; each sprint is one compact row with a short name, state, done of total, percentage and ETA, active first, with the full detail on request; a landing whose item is done, dropped or gone is not shown as in progress; a paid benchmark run shows its run of the planned runs per arm, its spend against the cap and its sandbox disk; today's cost is broken down by sprint, session and model

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
